title: Petrov's Defense: Modern Attack
line: White pushes into the center at once. Black takes the pawn on e4 and trades off the strong white knight.

steps.text: Petrov's Defense, and White pushes a second pawn into the center, leaving the pawn on e4.
Take the pawn on e4. Nothing guards it.

also.e5d4: Taking the other pawn is also played. This lesson takes on e4.

steps.text: Guard the knight with a pawn: push the pawn in front of your queen two squares.
steps.after: White takes your pawn on e5. Its knight stands strong in the center.

steps.text: Bring your other knight out to offer a trade with that strong knight.

also.f8d6: That is also played. This lesson offers the knight trade.

steps.text: Take back with the bishop. It comes out at the same time.
Bring the other bishop out, aimed at the king side.

also.f8e7: That is also played. This lesson puts the bishop on d6.

steps.text: Castle. Your king leaves the center, where the files may open.

also.c7c6: Guarding your center pawn is also played. This lesson castles first.

steps.after: The white pawn attacks your bishop on d6.

steps.text: Step the bishop back to e7. It stays near your king and keeps the game level.
steps.after: Your knight on e4 stands well, and White's knight is gone. The game is level.

summary: Black takes the pawn, guards the knight with a pawn, and trades off the white knight that jumps into the center.
